title: Copilot Notebooks: Power BI reports as references
summary: Hold: the Graph automation is presented beside a group-scoped control, but Microsoft says it fails when that setting is configured in a group-level policy. The page also overstates how completely disabling Notebooks blocks existing content, and carries a Copilot Chat data-freshness rule into Notebooks without documentation.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Scope: Roles
claims.claim: The group-scoped Notebooks policy is under Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote:
Select Customization from the left pane.
Select Policy Management.
Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one.
From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors in applyOnce mode automates the adjacent group-scoped Notebooks control using microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks with value 0 or 1.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center.
claims.fix: Keep the endpoint, but qualify controls[0].note and the rendered note: 'Beta automation is tenant-level only, not group-scoped. The setting must not be configured in any group-level policy or applyOnce fails. Set mode to applyOnce and baseline resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks with properties.value "0" or "1".' The create endpoint and mode are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta; the scope restriction is at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Cloud Policy turns off Notebooks altogether and controls whether users can create and view them at all.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted. Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission. These files remain accessible in the following ways:
claims.fix: Change controls[0].governs and its rendered label to 'Whether users can create Notebooks and access the Notebooks module in the Copilot app'. Replace 'turns off all Notebooks', 'turns Copilot Notebooks off altogether' and 'turns off Copilot Notebooks entirely' with 'blocks new Notebook creation and hides the Notebooks module in the Copilot app'. Add to the note and explanatory prose: 'Existing items are not deleted; users with permission can still view and edit existing items through the documented access routes.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-admin-configuration.
